description: Get one deposit address with its 20 most recent deposits (orders, quoteId starting with dep_): amount deposited and delivered, status (submitted, pending, filled, refunded, failed) and tx hashes. Tell the user: send ONLY srcToken on srcChain to the address (other tokens or chains may be lost for good), at least $1 worth; refundTo must be the user's own address on srcChain, never an exchange (CEX) deposit address. Needs a LayerHop API key; test keys (lh_test_) give a fake sandbox address that must never receive real funds. Read-only.
name: get_deposit_address
title: Get a deposit address and its deposits
